laserPage.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
laserPage.faq.q1.question: Which laser is right for me?
laserPage.faq.q1.answer: The optimal laser varies depending on skin condition and concerns. Through free consultation, our specialists will directly analyze your skin and propose a customized treatment plan.
laserPage.faq.q2.question: Is laser treatment painful?
laserPage.faq.q2.answer: It varies by device, but most describe it as "like a rubber band snapping." We minimize pain with numbing cream when needed. Clarity II has a built-in cooling system for added comfort.
laserPage.faq.q3.question: How long is the downtime?
laserPage.faq.q3.answer: It depends on the laser type. Laser toning and Ulblanc have almost no downtime, allowing immediate return to daily activities. Pico laser may cause mild redness for 3-5 days.
laserPage.faq.q4.question: When will I see results?
laserPage.faq.q4.answer: You can feel skin tone improvement immediately after treatment, with effects becoming more prominent over 2-4 weeks as collagen remodeling occurs. We recommend completing the suggested number of sessions for optimal results.
